description: Return the shopper's saved default size and fit. Call this BEFORE asking the user for a size — if a default is set, apply it automatically (add_to_cart uses it when size is omitted), and search in their fit: search_products style='oversized' for oversized, style='tee' for basic.
name: get_user_prefs

fit.description: Saved fit preference: basic | oversized, or null.

title: Get saved size/fit
